title: The realm of steel catwalks
content: Did you ever have the catwalk dream? Where you're in a giant factory and there's steel catwalks everywhere. I had that dream, the gates were closed on the catwalks, but then i realized i was dreaming, so i just walked through the steel like the liquid metal cop guy from terminator. Then i was just flying around and having fun, and all the factory workers started gathering around and looking at me. Then one of them said "he knows it's a dream", and pulled a lever that sent me down a chute and i landed into a proper dream after that
